newsitem.title: UK: Conoco says N.Sea Buckland test successful.
newsitem.headline: Conoco says N.Sea Buckland test successful.

text.p: Dupont unit Conoco (U.K.) Ltd said on Thursday an appraisal well at its Buckland field in the North Sea produced an oil flow rate of 4,265 barrels per day (bpd).

The field, which lies in block 9/18a about 210 miles north east of Aberdeen with estimated recoverable reserves of about 40 million barrels of oil, is jointly owned by Repsol Exploration (UK) Ltd (33.33 percent) and Mobil North Sea Ltd (26.83 percent).

Operator Conoco holds the remaining 39.83 percent equity but is looking to sell its stake as part of a broader disposal of North Sea assets, including others in the same area and some exploration acreage.
Appraisal well 9/18a-28 was drilled to a total depth of 12,109 feet by the semi-submersible rig Borgsten Dolphin, Conoco said.
In addition to the oil flow, the well tested 4.4 million standard cubic feet of gas per day through a 40/64th choke.
